text:
marie: quick sync to lock MVP scope for the Optimizer / Inference Advisor. Goal: deliver recommendations (batching, caching, quant) + eval-triggered alerts to pilot customers. keep it narrow.

ajay: agree. propose we explicitly call out exclusions so sales doesn't promise them: no autoscale policy changes, no tenant-aware batch packing, no on-prem private bundle in MVP.

marie: MVP IN: 1) per-route recs UI + API, 2) one-click apply that triggers manual approval, 3) server-side eval-triggered alerts (webhook/email), 4) simple audit log and acceptance metrics. MVP OUT: rollout automation, kms integrations, on-device alerting.

liam: engineering: quant recs will be ruleset + confidence score. no auto-apply at first. estimate ~3w dev + 1w stabilization.

sofia: acceptance criteria suggestion: pilot with 3 customers, p95 latency regression <=5% vs baseline, recommendation acceptance >=30% in 14 days, eval-alert false-positive rate <=10% during pilot.

katie-sre: add gating: block any rec that risks p99 > +10%. must include ops runbook for alert storms (rate limit, auto-silence).

marie: noted. also product wants per-model cost delta estimate surfaced in UI when previewing a quant change.

ajay: for eval alerts — server-side only for MVP, expose config for customers to export later. on-device is deferred.

liam: sample alert config we plan to support (YAML snippet):
```yaml
name: eval_regression_high
trigger: eval.delta_concordance < -0.05
window: 24h
actions: [webhook, email]
confidence_threshold: 0.7
```

sofia: UI must show failing prompt sets and 3 example diffs so customers can triage quickly.

marie: pilot gating checklist (draft): onboarding doc + 30m quickstart, 3 pilot customers onboarded, metrics dashboard live in Console (latency/cost/acceptance), runbook & playbook ready, legal ok to use anonymized evals.

katie-sre: runbook items: mute noisy alerts, rollback quant profiles (CLI + Console), revert cache settings, emergency rollback commands.

ajay: field asks: include predicted quality delta per prompt set and label as heuristic. we'll show mean-concordance estimate and confidence band.

liam: risk callout: long-tail prompts -> low prediction reliability. flag low-confidence recs and prevent apply. that's acceptable for pilot.

marie: decision: proceed with server-side eval-alerts + recs + Console dashboard for pilot. exclude on-prem and autoscale/fancy batching. acceptance = sofia + katie-sre thresholds. next: liam to post task breakdown, ajay to mock UX/API, sofia to shortlist pilot customers.

liam: will post JIRA tasks and estimates by EOD tomorrow.

ajay: I'll drop a Figma with recommendation card + apply flow this afternoon.

sofia: reaching out to 5 candidates, will pick 3 that are ok with eval sharing.

deploy-bot: please add feature flag `inference_advisor_mvp` to the launch matrix before previews.

marie: filing this as the scope-lock for the sprint. tagging roadmap and sending to stakeholders. :+1:
